search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on itemId or name.

fields.description: Which per-item keys to emit. Default: all. Use ["itemId","name"] to list a large category cheaply.

seed.description: Any string; the same seed always produces the same character(s). Default: empty string.

gear.description: Gear profile: how likely weapons/armour/hats are. Default: civilian.

preview.description: Also render a walk preview strip (inline PNG). Default: true.

scale.description: Nearest-neighbor upscale factor. Default 1 (2 for the random/design preview conveniences).

animations.sheetLayout: 13 columns x 54 rows of 64px frames (832x3456); each animation occupies `directionRows` rows starting at `row` (64px each); directions order = up,left,down,right; frames are actually-present frame columns.

watering.label: watering
watering.notes: alias: shares the thrust row block

combat.label: combat
combat.notes: canonical name of the combat_idle row block (get_animation and get_preview also accept combat_idle)

1h_slash.label: 1h_slash
1h_slash.notes: alias: shares the backslash row block

animations.customNote: Custom blocks are appended below the standard 54-row sheet and can also widen the canvas (up to 1664px with 128/192px frames). They appear in a render only when the character includes an item from usedBy. Blocks with available:false are defined upstream but no item in this pack provides them, so no character can render them.
